body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. PR #1026 merge `7493f9864c351a2b482329afdd86b2716553ce59`, reviewed head `7c871b5fbc809eb31d9b4b6ffa008efbcd44327a`; producing issue #1017 is closed and its canonical author reservation is released.

The original `data/regional-review/followup-yugoslavia-423-serbia-register-20261005/reproduce.py` opens all five retained products for replacement: subject-crosswalk.csv, parent-register-comparison.csv, neighboring-city-municipality-context.csv, validation/controls.json and reproduction-summary.json. Running the documented command replaces original historical evidence instead of checking it or preserving it. Its hardcoded ten whole-input SHA guards work; this finding does not claim otherwise.

Actual isolated verification, Python 3.12.14, exact merge: two executions with only the five exact output destinations redirected to fresh exclusive Auditor scratch files reproduced every retained output byte. Complete phase admission: 12 whole baseline inputs plus all 11 whole packet files and 8 MiB reserve = 17,333,867 bytes; no ordinary object exceeds 32 MiB. Independently checked all 67 actual Atlas identities/names/parents and original shape identities, 67 unique old/current code/name/parent joins, all 12 complete current parent code sets and nine urban-municipality context rows. The other #998 crosswalk's 78 IDs have zero intersection. Native workbook parsing is reused from audit #1014 under the same exact workbook/normalized CSV hashes, rather than claimed as a new parse.

Executed defect reproduction: pre-create each of the five owned scratch destinations with `AUDITOR EXISTING OUTPUT SENTINEL\n`, intercept only the original five output opens to those destinations, and preserve the original `w` mode. Execute the unchanged merged runner. It succeeds and silently replaces every sentinel with the retained report bytes. All original tracked files remain byte-identical. This is an actual output-preservation failure, not a numerical defect in the historical reports. A direct documented command on a writable original packet has the same five replacement modes.

Actual useful negative controls: a complete captured-issue fixture removing one subject (67→66) is rejected with AssertionError before any output open; a complete original scope fixture with only a trailing newline is rejected by the immutable SHA guard before output. Preserve both safeguards. The retained ambiguous-join control invokes an isolated `len == 1` helper on two literal candidates; it does not exercise the real reader/join/dedup path. The controls' method_id `crosswalk` also differs from the manifest's `register-crosswalk`; the current manifest gate does not bind that unlisted control collection. Supply honest method-linked executable controls in the additive reproducer.

Expected and success criteria, bounded additive geography evidence erratum, at most two PRs:

- Write only inside the new owned prefix below. Preserve every original script, claim, captured issue, workbook, source, normalized roster, CSV, control and manifest. Enforce all consumed immutable whole-file/code/scope pins and exact 67-ID acceptance before any result emission. Keep the existing real source SHA guards.
- Produce fresh exclusive versioned outputs or read-only comparisons. Reject an existing destination before replacing anything, including when a later destination already exists; prove all earlier destinations and originals stay untouched. Do not allow a successful run to overwrite retained products.
- Run twice and compare all five products against the original hashes. Independently verify exact subject/source/Atlas correspondence, 67 joins, 12 roster sets, nine contextual rows and disjoint #998 subjects. Add meaningful executable missing/duplicate/outside subject, wrong immutable input and preexisting-output controls, with actual method/input/output bindings and independent exact-head review. Clearly distinguish input-hash rejection from testing an ambiguous join.

Readiness: whole pinned inputs are available and bounded; closed #1017 has released its reservation. Complete open/closed issue pagination (12 pages, final page 85) and all open PR bodies found no existing owner of this new prefix or open corrective PR for this runner. #1175 owns the different #998 runner and disjoint 78-subject erratum. #1156 owns the original #992 restoration/reproduction/source gap; #1180 owns #1020's anomaly runner; their scopes and worker ownership remain intact. No implementation reservation is taken here.

Limits: official RGA dated/effective polygons, exact release and reusable license remain unavailable. SORS/RGA cited webpage bodies and underlying rights notices are not independently authenticated by this audit's GitHub-only access; the original audit remains Incomplete. This task repairs a mechanical preservation defect using retained bytes, not institutional source restoration, historical legal roles, polygon equivalence, geography approval, import, publication, merge or deployment.

Whole immutable inputs below use their actual baseline/merge commits; all 23 have been verified. Original source metadata and current workbook's missing reference date must remain explicit.
